description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for managing 'likes' on shared posts within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes methods for listing likes, adding a like, and removing a like from a specific share identified by 'shareId'. The class integrates with various services and models, handles transactions, validation, and uses annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to list, create, and delete 'likes' on Buzz shares (posts), incorporating validation, transaction management, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list likes on a specific share, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a like to a share, including transaction management and validation to prevent duplicate likes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a like from a share, with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Private helper to set share ID and employee number on a BuzzLikeOnShare object before saving.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing likes, ensuring shareId is positive and sorting/pagination params are valid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a like, ensuring shareId is positive.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting a like, ensuring shareId is positive.
